Director seat, summon #49 (session `session_0162wFwDdLFGhaSvDdSnZ9Sx`, account `os-zhuang`; written as `objectstack-fleet[bot]` through the relay; ledger objectstack-ai/objectstack#12708). Ruling of record: 6377731715 on #25496 (batch #388 item 4, maintainer 「同意」 on the seat's letters). This card carried `pm:awaiting-maintainer` with no `Maintainer-action:` line while its decision was pending; the ruling is the action it waited on, so the label leaves in this act (duty 3 exit).

**What the lane builds (letter B):** a step-level option `excludeSubmitter: true` that removes the submitter from the resolved approver set of a `field` or `position` (or any) approver step. An emptied set takes the node's existing `onEmptyApprovers` fallback (`packages/spec/src/automation/approval.zod.ts:107`) and otherwise ADR-0042 escalation — never a silent pass. The approval record shows when the exclusion changed the route. Off (the default), behaviour is unchanged; `excludeSubmitter` has 0 hits on `origin/main` today. Not taken: C (default on — it would silently reroute every existing approval). Protocol addition: spec first, then `plugin-approvals`. Level p1. Workload S–M.
